title: POC Scoping - Public Sector contractor (Orchard Signal)
summary: POC scoping for a government-adjacent workload. Explicit requirement for in-country hosting and that model inference happens within national borders.
next_steps: Redwood to propose Private deployment plan
Customer to confirm target country and accreditation needs
transcript:
Meeting: POC Scoping - Public Sector contractor (Orchard Signal)
Date: 2025-02-20
Duration: 36 min

[00:00] Camila (Redwood): Thanks. Lets define success criteria for the POC.
[00:12] Dana (Orchard Signal): Were supporting an agency program. The big constraint is hosting.

[01:05] Eric (Orchard Signal): The agency requires in-country hosting. Inference has to happen inside the country boundary, not just storage.
[01:18] Camila: Okay, so residency/sovereignty. Which country?
[01:22] Dana: Cant name it on this call, but assume strict. We can do details under NDA.

[03:40] Rohan (Redwood): That points to Private deployment. We can run in your VPC or on-prem, and you can restrict egress.
[03:55] Eric: Also any logging, traces, support artifacts  they have to stay there too.

[09:10] Dana: Timeline: we need a POC in 6 weeks.
[09:18] Camila: Understood. Well propose a phased plan.

[17:30] Eric: On models, open weights preferred. No external API calls out.
[17:42] Rohan: We support curated open models; in Private, its self-contained.

[34:50] Camila: Recap: strict in-country processing is a gating requirement. Next well get details under NDA and draft a deployment plan.
